title: Texas's highest hour of demand in late January
source: Source: EIA, Hourly Electric Grid Monitor (EIA-930), Texas region demand. The highest hour from 23 January to 2 February (UTC days), 2020-2026. The window is the days the ERW gives to the January 2026 cold; another window moves the peaks.
